- **Principal**: `AuthenticatedPrincipal` → `PrincipalContext.forApp/forGimbal` :111-114 writes request attribute `ATTR_PRINCIPAL = "mvp.principal"` (:44). `PrincipalContext` record :17-24: `principalType, accountUuid, installationId, gimbalUuid, credentialVersion, sessionId, requestId`. `PrincipalType {APP, GIMBAL}`. Injected into controllers by `PrincipalContextArgumentResolver` :19-36.
- **“Only GIMBAL” = explicit check, no annotation.** Pattern: `AssessmentController.requireGimbal` :123-128 → `throw new ApiException(ErrorCode.CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED, …)` (403); same in `GimbalAiService.openStream` :52-55. Non-self device → `CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED` (`AssessmentReadService.currentAssessment` :79-83).
- **401/403 “problem+json”**: the repo does **not** use RFC7807 `application/problem+json` for its own responses. It returns the project's JSON `ErrorEnvelope` via `ApiException` + `GlobalExceptionHandler.apiException` :62-66 / filter `render`. Error codes/status live in `ErrorCode.java` (CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED=403, RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE=404, TASK_REPLACED=409, AUTH_REQUIRED/SESSION_INVALID=401, DEPENDENCY_*=503/504). Reuse this system for pre-stream errors.

## 4. requestId generation / propagation

- `RequestIdFilter.java:21-42`, `@Order(HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)`: always **server-generates** `UUID.randomUUID()` (does not trust inbound `X-Request-Id`), stores request attr `"mvp.requestId"`, sets response header `X-Request-Id`, puts MDC key `"requestId"`.
- `BearerAuthFilter` copies it into `PrincipalContext.requestId` :108-113. Helpers: `EnvelopeSupport.requestId(HttpServletRequest)` :19-22; `principal.requestId()`.
- For SSE event payloads, capture `principal.requestId()` / task/report ids in the lambda closure — **MDC is not propagated** to the async stream thread. (Downstream `HttpGimbalAiClient` generates its own per-call `X-Request-Id`; irrelevant to a mock.)

## 5. OpenAPI / contract sync convention

- Authoritative hand-authored contract: **`backend/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml`**. M3 paths at lines 564, 639, 713, 752, 792. Typical operation block (e.g. `:713-751`): `operationId`, `tags`, Chinese `summary`, `x-api-id: M3-Axx`, `x-implementation: contract-only`, `x-error-codes: [...]`, Chinese `description`, `security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]`, `parameters`, `responses` (200 `application/json` `SuccessEnvelope allOf data: $ref`; `$ref` 4xx/5xx responses).
- The existing SSE endpoint `POST /api/v1/gimbal-ai/messages` is **not** in openapi.yaml — see `docs/catalog/GimbalAiDocs.java:19-20` (user-authorized increment; no contract `x-error-codes` to cross-check). So two accepted precedents exist: contract-backed (M3 family) or catalog-only (gimbal-ai).
- **Docs catalog pattern**: `backend/web-java/src/main/java/cn/yuanxin/mvp/web/docs/catalog/*.java` implement `ApiDocsCatalog`; map key is `"METHOD path"`. M3 entries in `AssessmentApiDocs.java` (:37, entries :61-415). SSE success is documented with `ApiDocEntry.SuccessDoc.binary("200", desc, "text/event-stream")` (`GimbalAiDocs.java:101-105`), error codes list `:106-108`. Catalog beans are gated `@Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)` + `@ConditionalOnProperty(springdoc.api-docs.enabled=true)`.
- **Engine**: `ApiDocsApplier` applies catalogs to the generated `/v3/api-docs`; every generated op must be covered (`missingOperations` :209-214). New op must have a catalog entry.
- **Gate**: `ApiDocsCoverageIT` requires Chinese `summary`+`description`, exactly one tag, ≥1 declared 4xx/5xx, params documented, all schema properties described, ≥5 schemas with examples, and **if** the contract op has `x-api-id`, generated `x-error-codes` must equal contract `x-error-codes` and success codes must match (`contractOperations()` :1301-1340; `expected == null` → cross-check skipped, which is how gimbal-ai passes). Contract path is read as `Path.of("..","contracts","openapi","openapi.yaml")` :1304 (run tests from `backend/web-java`).
- **Scripts**: `backend/contracts/scripts/jcs.py` (RFC8785 reference), `validate_samples.py` (samples/ + schemas/ + canonicalization vectors), `validate_responses.py` (**only** the echo-jobs response, `ECHO_VIEW_PATH` :36). None are generic per-endpoint validators. `backend/tests/run-acceptance.sh:264-268` runs `openapi_spec_validator` on openapi.yaml (step c3) — any openapi.yaml edit must stay spec-valid. Adding an SSE path to the contract requires a valid `text/event-stream` schema and matching 4xx/5xx `$ref`s; adding samples is not required for event streams.
- New M3 endpoint convention: add `GET /api/v1/skin-assessment-tasks/{taskId}/report-narration-stream` to openapi.yaml with a new `x-api-id` (e.g. M3-A07), `x-error-codes` exactly matching the implementation, `200 content: text/event-stream` + `$ref` error responses; add an `AssessmentApiDocs` entry with the identical `errorCodes()`; if instead kept out of the contract, follow the `GimbalAiDocs` catalog-only pattern.

## 7. Mock/stub labeling convention

- `app.providers.mode` (`application.yml:76-78`): default `doubles`; `disabled` → capability-branching 503; `real` required in prod. Provider-specific keys also exist: `app.sms.provider`, `app.face.provider`, `app.storage.provider` (all default `doubles`).
- Doubles wiring: `TestDoubleProvidersConfig.java:30-33` — `@Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)` + `@ConditionalOnProperty(name="app.providers.mode", havingValue="doubles", matchIfMissing=true)`. Doubles live in `cn.yuanxin.mvp.web.testdouble` (`InMemorySessionDouble`, `SmsCodeDouble`, `FaceProviderDouble`, `FileSystemStorageDouble`, `DeviceCredentialDouble`).
- `ProductionFailClosedValidator.java:78` treats any bean whose package contains `.testdouble` or class name starts with `Disabled` as non-real → **startup fails in production**. Docs catalogs use the same `@Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)` gate.
- Convention for the mock narration generator: label it explicitly as a non-production mock — either place it under `.testdouble` and/or annotate `@Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)` / `@ConditionalOnProperty(app.providers.mode=doubles)`, and disclose “mock/non-production” in the catalog description. It must not silently serve mock data under production signals.

### Implementation caveats to carry into the task
- Endpoint must stay under `/api/**` so `BearerAuthFilter` applies; use `GET` + `@PathVariable UUID taskId`, explicit `principal.principalType() != GIMBAL → 403 CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED`, then `AssessmentReadService.getTask` (or `SkinReportService`) **before** returning the `StreamingResponseBody`, so 401/403/404/409/500 go through `GlobalExceptionHandler` JSON. Under MockMvc, streamed bodies need `asyncDispatch` (the existing streaming IT uses a real port instead).
- Event contract from the task: `start`/`text_delta`/`done`/`error`, `data` JSON = `{requestId, taskId, reportId, seq}` (+`delta` on `text_delta`), ≥2 flushed deltas; reuse the `writeEvent`-style framing (`event: X\ndata: <json>\n\n` + flush) and `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Content-Type: text/event-stream`.
